description: One-B70 Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 4.00bpw on vLLM 0.26.1 XPU with the exl3xpu plugin (bit-exact EXL3 trellis decode in ESIMD kernels), MTP speculative decoding k=3, fp8 KV cache (272,570 tokens in 1600-token blocks), 262,144-token context, 16 sequences, image and video input (up to 32 images / 4 videos per request; images above 4.2 MP are downscaled). Measured on one card with thinking on: C1 decode 63-77 tok/s, C8 aggregate 294-363 tok/s, C16 344-410 tok/s; cold prefill 2,421 (4K) / 2,259 (32K) / 1,415 (128K) / 911 (254K) tok/s with int8 prefill linears (EXL3_INT8_PREFILL=1: W8A8 on the XMX units, Hadamard-domain activations with per-row scales, one static codebook weight scale; teacher-forced NLL +0.17%, decode unchanged and bit-exact) and oneDNN Graph fused attention for long prefixes (EXL3_ONEDNN_ATTN=1: +7-18% over FA2, needle 6/6 at 131K/240K), vs 1,654 / 1,434 / 928 / 650 for the fp16 recipe; real omp agent sessions replayed with tools + thinking: 24/24 turns ok, TTFT p50 4.65 -> 3.78 s (int8 alone); 4096-token chunks (decode waits <=~3.7 s behind a long prompt). Same card, qwen38-q4km-arcb70-llamacpp-tp1: C1 25.0, C8 56.8, prefill 32K 629. Prefix caching is on (--enable-prefix-caching; vLLM 0.26 leaves it off for hybrid GDN models): a repeated 14.4K-token prompt goes from 11.1 s to 1.8 s TTFT, decode is unchanged (greedy prose C8 334 vs 338 tok/s), and cold prefill costs 5-12% (1,636 / 1,423 / 923 tok/s at 4K / 32K / 128K) because align-mode chunks round to 1600-token blocks.

acceptance.harness: scripts/accept_recipe.py via ssh tunnel to omarchy, published image digest 21412bdd (int8 prefill + oneDNN attention) on one B70 (single render node + filtered by-path), recipe launch args

correctness.weights_bit_exact: all 401 EXL3 tensors bit-identical to exllamav3 reconstruct (tests/test_bitexact_xpu.py)

tools_check.host: omarchy test box, Intel Arc Pro B70 (intel-xpu:0)
tools_check.result: claude, codex, opencode, pi, omp, crush, grok and copilot each answered a one-shot prompt through the keyed gateway; without these flags every agent got 400 (auto tool choice needs --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser)

metadata.tuning_delta: 2026-09-25: +int8 prefill and +oneDNN fused attention: cold prefill 4K 1654->2421, 32K 1434->2259, 128K 928->1415, 254K 650->911 tok/s; omp replay TTFT p50 4.65->3.78 s (int8); NLL +0.17% (docs/PROGRESS.md in exl3xpu)

serving.speculative: mtp k=3 (EXL3 MTP head in the checkpoint), draft lm_head pruned to 512 vocab blocks
